en: A vintage postcard printed in orange ink showing a simplified route map around Nijmegen and the Maas/Waal rivers. It is titled in Dutch at the top and includes place names such as Numege(n), Hatert, Heumen, Malden, Mook, Middelaar, Groesbeek, Berg en Dal, Grave, Beers, and Cuijk. Distances for marching routes (30 km, 40–50–55 km, etc.) are marked along the roads, with a north arrow and a scale of 1:150,000. There is a printed date line for an 'Eerste Marschdag' with a later stamp marking the year 1935. At the bottom right appears the phrase 'Nadruk verboden.'
